sections.heading: MahaDBT document submission guidelines.
body: The Aaple Sarkar DBT portal (MahaDBT) requires students applying for Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj, Post-Matric, and EBC scholarships to upload verified PDF documents capped under 200 KB per entry.
Scanned government certificates often contain heavy background watermarks and stamp seals that increase PDF file sizes beyond the 200 KB portal limit.

sections.heading: Local compression built for student data privacy.
body: Zcompressor processes your certificates locally. Sensitive personal identifiers like your Aadhaar number, income details, and domicile registration numbers remain strictly on your computer or smartphone screen.

faq.q: What is the maximum PDF size allowed on MahaDBT portal?
faq.a: Most document uploads on mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in require files to be under 200 KB in PDF format.

faq.q: Can I compress scanned income certificates from phone scan apps?
faq.a: Yes! Phone scanner apps frequently generate 3 MB+ files. Zcompressor compresses these scanned image PDFs down to under 200 KB while keeping stamp text clear.
